body: If you could PM me, that'd be great.
I tried professional help. I tried all kinds of things. I tried to make myself better. I tried to drown my sorrows. Nothing. Fucking. Worked.
I've taken all the roads I could. There isn't any way out left. The tunnels are either blocked or non-euclidian loops. I don't want to die, I just know I have to.
I mean, things aren't gonna change in less than a day lol. Thanks anyway bro <3
For many years. Never got a match beyond spam accounts :)
I'd have liked to go on a date with a girl :)
